import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for a comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(breed_counts.index[::-1], breed_counts.values[::-1], color=colors[::-1])
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
# Add value labels on bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, breed_counts.values[::-1]):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}', 
             va='center', fontsize=8)

# 2. Dog Registrations by District (Kreis)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
ax2.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)

# 3. Dog Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Filter out missing values and get age distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
sns.histplot(data=age_data, bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax3, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax3.legend(fontsize=9)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation of owner gender and dog gender
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#95A5A6'], edgecolor='white', width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', fontsize=9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Add a text box with summary statistics
total_dogs = df['AnzHunde'].sum()
unique_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].nunique()
avg_age = age_data.mean()
fig.text(0.5, 0.02, f'Total Registrations: {total_dogs:,} | Unique Breeds: {unique_breeds} | Average Dog Age: {avg_age:.1f} years', 
         ha='center', fontsize=10, style='italic', 
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='lightgray', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
